reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses the shared linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, but the transaction download copies downloadAkahuTransactions and the takeover unlink copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with a different URL, and the replacedIds loop repeats the exact updateAccount reset from unlinkAccount; the assert call is also repeated in all six provider wrappers.

placement.why: Validation, linking and sync stay in their existing modules; calling the guard in each provider wrapper (needed so it runs before findOrCreateBank) rather than in one place is acceptable but spreads the rule's entry points.

scope.why: Covers the four steps; includes an unrelated import reordering in schedules/app.ts and small client edits forced by the new provider key.

maintainability.why: The validation helper is clear and single, but two copied blocks (download, unlink reset) must now be kept in sync with their originals.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers go through linkBankSyncAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked; no existing download or unlink helper was abstracted to bypass, they were copied.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions, app.ts replacedIds unlink loop) are plain, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replacedIds and assertBankAccountNotLinked takes replaceExistingLink; both carry the requested takeover variation, every provider calls them, no provider-specific branches added.
